'''El-Sayed Mohamed Abo-Dahab Khedary''' is an Egyptian Applied Mathematics professor at the Mathematics Department, Faculty of Science, [[South Valley University]], [[Qena]] in [[Egypt]]. He is a part of the editorial board of [[Applied and Computational Mathematics|Applied and computational Mathematics]] and also one of the editors of Arabian Journal of Science.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Editorial Team |url=https://ojs.whioce.com/index.php/vd/about/editorialTeamBio/6147 |access-date=2022-06-25 |website=ojs.whioce.com |archive-date=2020-07-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200714023323/http://ojs.whioce.com/index.php/vd/about/editorialTeamBio/6147 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Editorial Team |url=https://probe.usp-pl.com/index.php/MMS/about/editorialTeamBio/1261 |access-date=2022-06-25 |website=probe.usp-pl.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Arabian Journal of Science editors |url=http://www.arabianjournalofscience.com/index.php/AJSI/about/editorialTeam |access-date=2022-06-25 |archive-date=2015-08-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150822193018/http://arabianjournalofscience.com/index.php/AJSI/about/editorialTeam |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=السيد محمد أبو دهب خضيرى |url=http://app.svu.edu.eg/arabic/staff/application/result.aspx?id_num=1251 |access-date=2022-06-25 |website=app.svu.edu.eg}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Elsayed M. Abo-Dahab was born in  Egypt at [[Sohag]]- [[El Maragha|El-maragha]]-[[Ezbet El Borg|Ezbet]] to the tribe of  [[Banu Hilal|Banu-Hilal]] in 1973. In 1995, he obtained his B.Sc. (Ed) in Mathematics from South Valley University and bagged another degree in Pure mathematics from the same Institution in 1997. In 2001, he received his master's degree in Applied Mathematics and obtained his doctorate degree in 2005 from [[Assiut University|Assuit University]] in 2005.<ref name=":0"/><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Abd-Alla |first1=A. M. |last2=Abo-Dahab |first2=S. M. |last3=Al-Thamali |first3=T. A. |date=2012-09-01 |title=Propagation of Rayleigh waves in a rotating orthotropic material elastic half-space under initial stress and gravity |url=https://doi.org/10.1007/s12206-012-0736-5 |journal=Journal of Mechanical Science and Technology |language=en |volume=26 |issue=9 |pages=2815–2823 |doi=10.1007/s12206-012-0736-5 |s2cid=11705951 |issn=1976-3824|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref name=":1"/><ref name=":3" />

== Career ==

In 2006, he became a lecturer of mathematics at the faculty of science South Valley University. In 2012, he moved to [[Taif University]], [[Saudi Arabia|KSA]] where he became an associate professor. In 2017, he returned to South Valley University where he became a professor of Applied Mathematics.<ref name=":0"/><ref name=":3" />

== Memberships ==
He is a member of the Egyptian Mathematical Society and Member of the editorial board of Journal of Modern Methods in Numerical Mathematics.

== Awards and honors ==
Abo-Dahab has received several national and institutional recognitions for his scientific contributions to applied mathematics and continuum mechanics:
* '''South Valley University Incentive Prize''' (2011) – Awarded by South Valley University for research excellence in basic sciences.<ref>{{cite web |title=تعيين الدكتور السيد أبو الدهب قائما بأعمال عميد حاسبات ومعلومات جامعة الأقصر |url=https://www.youm7.com/story/2021/2/18/%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A3%D8%A8%D9%88-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%87%D8%A8-%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%85%D8%A7-%D8%A8%D8%A3%D8%B9%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%88%D9%85%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA/5212206 |website=Youm7 |access-date=13 September 2026}}</ref>

* '''Professor Dr. Amin Lotfy Prize in Mathematics''' (2014) – Conferred by the Academy of Scientific Research and Technology (ASRT) for outstanding research in mathematical sciences.<ref name="Youm7-AboDahab">{{cite news |last=Mar'i |first=Ahmed |title=Appointment of Dr. Elsayed Abo-Dahab as Acting Dean of Computers and Information at Luxor University |url=https://www.youm7.com/story/2021/2/18/%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%8B%D8%A7%D8%AA/5212206 |work=[[Youm7]] |date=2021-02-18 |language=ar |access-date=2026-09-13}}</ref>

* '''State Incentive Prize in Mathematical Sciences''' (2015) – Awarded by the Egyptian Academy of Scientific Research and Technology (ASRT) as part of Egypt's annual State Prizes.<ref name="ASRT-Prizes">{{cite web |title=Full List of Egyptian State Prize Winners |url=http://www.crci.sci.eg/?p=1828 |publisher=Academy of Scientific Research and Technology |language=ar |access-date=2026-09-13}}</ref>
